usage: 영화관 = movie theater. 극장 is also used for cinemas.

examples.en: I eat popcorn at the movie theater.
The movie theater is too crowded on weekends.
Where are you going? — To the movie theater.
A movie ticket is 15,000 won.

examples.ko: 저는 영화를 좋아해요. 영화관에 자주 가요.
examples.en: I like movies. I go to the movie theater often.

explain: 영화관과 극장은 거의 같은 뜻으로 써요. 말할 때는 “영화관에 가요”보다 “영화 보러 가요”라고 많이 해요. 표는 보통 앱으로 미리 “예매해요”.
explain_en: 영화관 and 극장 are used almost the same way. In conversation, people often say "영화 보러 가요" (I'm going to see a movie) rather than "영화관에 가요." Tickets are usually booked in advance (예매해요) on an app.
